UserPromptSubmit.description: Auto-trigger commit skill when git commit/push keywords are mentioned

hooks.command: node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>s+=c).on("end",()=>{try{var p=String(JSON.parse(s||"{}").prompt||"");if(new RegExp("\\bcommit\\b|\\bpush\\b|commit and push","i").test(p))process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:"IMPORTANT: The user wants to commit/push. You MUST invoke the commit skill using the Skill tool BEFORE doing anything else."}}));}catch(e){}})'
